title: Introduction
summary: Introduces Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) similarity search, its challenges, and the focus on optimizing the refinement phase.

title: Preliminaries
summary: Defines EMD formally, presents the min‑cost flow formulation, and describes the filter‑and‑refinement framework.

title: Computing the EMD
summary: Explains how EMD is computed via linear programming and network‑flow algorithms, particularly the successive shortest path (SSP) method.

title: Filter‑and‑Refinement Framework
summary: Details the two‑phase search process, defining feasible edges, lower‑bound filters, and the overall k‑NN query procedure.

title: Scaling Up SSP
summary: Introduces the Simplified Incremental Algorithm (SIA) for efficiently building a partial flow graph and scaling EMD computation to large histograms.

title: Boosting the Refinement Phase
summary: Presents two techniques—Progressive Bounding (PB) and Dynamic Refinement Ordering (DRO)—to accelerate the refinement stage of EMD‑based similarity search.

title: Analysis of EMD Calculation
summary: Analyzes the cost distribution of SIA iterations, showing that most runtime is spent in late iterations.

title: Progressive Bounding
summary: Describes a running lower bound (emd−) that enables early termination of SIA when it exceeds the pruning threshold.

title: Sensitivity to Refinement Order
summary: Discusses how the order of candidate refinement impacts overall query performance and motivates dynamic ordering.

title: Dynamic Refinement Ordering
summary: Introduces the DRO algorithm, which maintains a priority layer of candidates based on emd− and refines them adaptively.

title: Running Upper Bound
summary: Defines a running upper bound (emd+) using a greedy maximum‑flow estimate to further prune candidates during refinement.

title: Experimental Evaluation
summary: Evaluates the proposed methods on six real datasets, comparing query times of various EMD computation techniques.

title: Performance Improvement
summary: Shows that SIA outperforms other black‑box EMD modules and that PB and DRO provide substantial speed‑ups, especially on large datasets.

title: Parameter Tuning in DRO
summary: Analyzes the impact of two sensitive DRO parameters—the maximum concurrent refined objects and the object prioritization function—on query performance.

title: Related Work
summary: Reviews prior research on Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) applications, filter‑and‑refinement techniques, and various approximation and indexing methods.

title: Conclusion
summary: Summarizes the paper's contributions in efficient EMD similarity evaluation, including progressive refinement and pruning strategies that reduce query cost.

title: Acknowledgment
summary: Recognizes funding sources and individuals who contributed code and feedback to the research.

title: References
summary: Lists cited works covering EMD theory, related algorithms, and applications across image retrieval, clustering, and privacy.
